question: BOARD: Prove that 5 is irrational. (Short answer: which key step makes the contradiction?)
question_hi: बोर्ड: √5 अपरिमेय है — प्रमाण में विरोधाभास कौन-सा है?
options: Both r and s are divisible by 5, contradicting HCF(r,s)=1
r² = 5 leads to r being irrational
5 cannot be written in any form
options_hi: r और s दोनों 5 से विभाज्य → HCF≠1, विरोधाभास
5 किसी भी रूप में नहीं लिखा जा सकता
explanation: Assume √5 = r/s (coprime). Then r²=5s² → 5|r → r=5c → s²=5c² → 5|s. Both r,s divisible by 5 → contradicts HCF(r,s)=1. ∴ √5 is irrational.
explanation_hi: r²=5s² → 5|r → r=5c → s²=5c² → 5|s → HCF≠1 → विरोधाभास → √5 अपरिमेय ∎
explanation_gu: r,s बंने 5 ना गुणज → HCF≠1 → विरोध → √5 अप्रमेय ∎

question: BOARD: Can LCM of two numbers ever be smaller than their HCF?
question_hi: बोर्ड: क्या LCM कभी HCF से छोटा हो सकता है?
options: No, LCM is always ≥ HCF for any two natural numbers
Yes, when one number divides the other
Yes, when both numbers are prime
options_hi: नहीं, LCM हमेशा ≥ HCF होता है
हाँ, जब एक दूसरे को विभाजित करता है
explanation: LCM is always a multiple of HCF. So LCM ≥ HCF always. LCM = HCF only when both numbers are equal.
explanation_hi: LCM, HCF का गुणज होता है। अतः LCM ≥ HCF हमेशा। LCM = HCF तभी जब दोनों संख्याएँ बराबर हों।
explanation_gu: LCM, HCF नो ગুणаकار → LCM ≥ HCF हमेशा

question: What is the HCF of 2³ × 3² × 5 and 2² × 3⁴?
question_hi: 2³×3²×5 और 2²×3⁴ का HCF क्या है?
explanation: HCF = smallest powers of COMMON factors. Both have 2 and 3. Smallest: 2² and 3². HCF = 2²×3² = 4×9 = 36.
explanation_hi: HCF = साझा गुणनखंडों की सबसे छोटी घात = 2²×3² = 36
